SASBDB entry SASDH39  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDH39/)

Publication: Prokaryotic Argonaute from Archaeoglobus fulgidus interacts with DNA as a homodimer.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-021-83889-4

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDH39/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
